overloadMerges.note: Two doc syntax lines differ only in the leading '*' discriminator; collapsed into one overload. Also fixed direction: startBlock/endBlock default to 'in' in the mechanical draft, but the doc's arrow column marks both '<-' (out) since the command returns the bounds of the first uniformly-typed block into them.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'object' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'object' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Variable/field reference (if '*' omitted)

params.name: startBlock
params.description: Start position of first type of selection

params.name: endBlock
params.description: End position of first type of selection

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a code identifying the type of content (plain text, expression, URL, picture, etc.) found at the start of a text selection in the designated styled-text object.
